params.name: action
params.description: Service action name. Must take the string value ```activate```.

params.name: client_id
params.description: Id of the client

params.name: nonce
params.description: A random token used to prevent replay attacks (Cf. [Signature v2 - Getnonce](#operation/signaturev2-getnonce))

params.name: signature
params.description: Hash of params (Cf. [Signature hash protocol](/developer-guide/v3/get-access/sign-your-requests)).

params.name: mailingpref
params.description: Specifies if customer accepted Withings commercial contacts.

params.name: birthdate
params.description: Unix timestamp of user's birthdate

params.name: measures
params.description: User measures (Cf. [Measures](#tag/models/Measures) model).

params.name: gender
params.description: 0: man, 1: woman

params.name: preflang
params.description: User language preference. Examples: en_EN / en_US / de_DE / es_ES / fr_FR / it_IT / ja_JA / ko_KR / nl_NL / pt_PT / ru_RU / zh_CN

params.name: unit_pref
params.description: Unit pref (cf. [Unit preferences](#tag/models/Unit-preferences) model).

params.name: email
params.description: User's email address

params.name: timezone
params.description: User's timezone. Examples: "Europe/Paris" / "America/New_York". A complete list of all possible timezones can be found on the "TZ database name" column of this page : https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

params.name: shortname
params.description:
3 characters representing the end user (ex: for a user named Robert, you could set the shortname param to ROB). These characters will be displayed on device screens when used.
Shortname must respect the following regex: /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{3}$/ (either letters or numbers, special characters and spaces are not allowed).

params.name: external_id
params.description: Unique identifier used by the partner to identify the end-user.

params.name: mac_addresses
params.description: List of Withings device MAC addresses that will be linked to the created user. Example: ["00:24:e4:xx:xx:xx","00:24:e4:xx:xx:xx"]

params.name: firstname
params.description: User's firstname (if not set, will take the same value as shortname)

params.name: lastname
params.description: User's lastname (if not set, will take the same value as shortname)

params.name: phonenumber
params.description: Phone number in E.164 format. End user will receive a verification code on this phone number for 2 factor authentication if they wish to securely access the data of their program in the withings app in the future (recommended)

params.name: recovery_code
params.description: Recovery code can be used by end user as a 2nd authentication factor in the withings app if they wish to securely access the data of their program in the future.  You will be responsible of securely providing this recovery code to your user if he asks for it.

params.name: goals
params.description: Goals (cf. [Goals](#tag/models/Goals) model).

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description:
The URI we should redirect the user to after choosing to authorize or not your app. This URI must be set as ```Callback Url``` in your partner application. It is possible to use multiple URLs by separating them with a comma.

Examples:

- Callbacks: https://mydomain.com/
- Callback: https://mydomain.com/,https://mydomain2.com/
- Valid URL: https://mydomain.com/relative_path?args=value

params.description: The section in which your patient will appear in the Withings RPM platform. Accepted value are: 0 (patient is in the program and doesn't have alert) or -6 (patient need manual validation)

items.docs:
Links the devices related to the provided ```mac_addresses``` and the user related to the provided ```access_token```. If a cellular device is listed in the ```mac_address``` field, it will activate this device's cellular service and invoicing.

**Important**:

- Please note that the devices need to be authorized to be linked by API by the Partner. Please [contact Withings](mailto:partner-api@withings.com) for more information on device authorization.
